contentHtml:
Most callers who hit voicemail just hang up. An AI receptionist actually talks to them instead, with a professional greeting, a natural conversation, and an instant summary sent to you so you can call back with all the detail you need. I set these up for businesses around Stretton and Brisbane, and it is running in about fifteen minutes.

The voicemail problem

Roughly eight in ten callers do not leave a voicemail, and a good share of business calls go unanswered in the first place. Every one of those is a job or a customer that quietly went to whoever picked up. For a small business, a missed call is often a missed sale.

How it works

  • The caller dials your number as they normally would.
  • The AI answers with a professional greeting in your own wording, and an Australian voice if you want one.
  • It has a real conversation, understands what the caller needs and gathers the key details.
  • You get an instant summary, so you can follow up quickly with the full picture.

Set up around your business

It runs 24 hours a day, so after-hours and overflow calls stop slipping through, and plans start from around $49 a month. I set it up with your greeting, your details and the questions you want it to ask. If you would like to understand the technology behind it, see my learn about AI service, and for wider office IT there is business IT support.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
